title: Alta Via 1
subtitle: Ten days hut to hut through the pale mountains

chapters.heading: Lago di Braies, 6 a.m.
chapters.body: The lake was glass and the crowds were still asleep. I shouldered a pack that felt far too heavy and started up toward the first rifugio, already second-guessing the third pair of socks.

image.caption: Lago di Braies before the day-trippers.

chapters.heading: Hut life
chapters.body: Strudel at 2,300 metres. Strangers sharing wine at long wooden tables. Every rifugio had a different smell of woodsmoke and boot leather, and every one felt like home within an hour.

image.alt: A mountain hut glowing at dusk
image.caption: Rifugio Lagazuoi, the highest bed of the trip.

chapters.heading: The via ferrata day
chapters.body: Cables bolted into rock, a drop that went on longer than my nerve. It was the hardest, best morning of the route, and the one I still dream about.

image.alt: Climber on a ladder against a cliff face
image.caption: Clipped in and not looking down.

chapters.heading: Coming down to Belluno
chapters.body: The last day was all knees and gratitude. The valley floor felt impossibly flat, and I missed the mountains before I had even left them.

image.alt: A green valley at golden hour
image.caption: The long descent.
